description: This file defines a custom web component `<iron-pages>` using Polymer. It manages a set of child elements, displaying only the selected page, and includes properties, behaviors, styles, templates, and scripting to control the component's functionality.

classes.name: iron-pages
classes.description: Custom element class extending Polymer, representing a container that displays one child at a time based on the 'selected' property.

methods.name: _selectedPageChanged
methods.description: Observer callback triggered when the 'selected' property changes, asynchronously notifying about resize.
